resident_environment_info.capture_scope: successful RGB captures with an uploaded directional environment; sky draw count is not foreground pixel count
resident_environment_info.snapshot: last live query; final GPU allocations are reported by teardown telemetry

resident_texture_info.capture_scope: successful RGB captures with bound texture instances, not visible textured pixel count
resident_texture_info.upload_scope: cumulative actual texture image and metadata GPU writes, including default white sentinel; excluded from geometry_upload_bytes
resident_texture_info.snapshot: last live query, not final allocation state; teardown verified by allocation telemetry

resident_readback.snapshot: last live query, not final mapping state; teardown verified by allocation telemetry
resident_readback.capacity_scope: logical Vulkan readback buffer capacity, not total VkDeviceMemory allocation size

resident_profile.scope: cumulative successful captures including warmup; excludes initial static geometry upload
resident_profile.gpu_scope: Vulkan timestamps: TLAS build/update plus raster and fragment shadows, then attachment copies; not fragment-only time
resident_profile.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final ownership is checked by telemetry

resident_telemetry.allocation_scope: this context explicit VkDeviceMemory allocations; not driver total VRAM
resident_telemetry.wait_scope: host wall time blocked in fence waits, including upload; not GPU kernel time

resident_ray_query_info.capture_scope: successful RGB-requested captures, not ray count or visible shadow pixel count
resident_ray_query_info.buffer_scope: logical AS and scratch buffer bytes; actual VkDeviceMemory allocation telemetry is separate
resident_ray_query_info.update_scope: each capture builds or updates TLAS, including two cameras at the same frame key
resident_ray_query_info.upload_scope: additional VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR records, 64 bytes per instance per capture; not the ordinary forward/inverse matrix buffer
resident_ray_query_info.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final allocation teardown is reported by resident telemetry

backend_before_close.geometry_residency: static indexed meshes; per-frame instance matrices
backend_before_close.primary_visibility: single-sample Vulkan raster, two-sided opaque triangles
backend_before_close.lighting: native GGX/Smith/Schlick plus explicit resident studio shader

basis_sources.fact: internalUpdate composes entity global pose with POSE_GL_TO_ROS before setting the renderer light transform
centered rectangle half width along GL +X, half height along GL +Y at shape angle pi/2

basis_sources.reference: installed SAPIEN 3.0.3 public headers and shipped rt shader
basis_sources.fact: GL_TO_ROS quaternion wxyz=(-.5,-.5,.5,.5); RT shader uses cross(edge0,edge1) dotted with point-to-light

studio.basis: entity shortest_rotation(+X to direction); halfU=R*(0,width,0), halfV=R*(0,0,height); U cross V emits
studio.rectangle_equivalence: same authored pi/2 rectangle; first GL edge reflected for emission-oriented normal
studio.arithmetic_scope: FP64 host basis packed to FP32; not bitwise equivalence to SAPIEN FP32 quaternion/trigonometric evaluation

environment.quantization: same RGBE shared 8-bit mantissa decode as reference uniform HDR

studio.units: metres; relative linear radiance, not calibrated photometric lux
studio.evaluation: native resident studio shader; distinct estimator from SAPIEN reference path tracing

environment.gloss: split-sum radiance prefilter, V=N, normalized positive N.L
environment.orientation: world Z up; Vulkan sampler ray.xzy; positive yaw turns +X toward +Y
environment.diffuse: world XYZ real SH9; exact texel solid-angle projection; irradiance divided by pi
environment.native_axis_transform: world xyz -> sampler xzy; SH basis remains world xyz
environment.native_layout: level-major, then six faces, top-row-first RGBA32F little endian
environment.native_roughness: perceptual roughness r -> mip LOD r*(levels-1); no second prefilter
environment.native_diffuse: shared normalized real SH9 coefficients already include Lambert convolution / pi
environment.native_environment_precedence: map replaces uniform scalar environment; rectangular panels and scene lights remain

backend_before_close.shadows: GPU fragment Vulkan hardware ray queries against BLAS/TLAS; primary visibility remains raster
backend_before_close.display: nonnegative linear exposure, Khronos PBR Neutral, then IEC sRGB once
backend_before_close.readback: explicit synchronous host-visible staging after fence; actual flags in resident_readback when available
backend_before_close.published_ownership: immutable CPU bytes; private resident host buffer may be reused after each copy
backend_before_close.lifecycle_counts: DLL-wide owned contexts, frames, and explicit Vulkan handles; pools own descriptor sets

texture_assets.image_encoding: top-row-first sRGB8 color, linear UNORM roughness or constant one in A
texture_assets.material_factor: linear base_color multiplied after sRGB texel decode in native shader
texture_assets.sampler: bilinear repeat, mip level 0, one wrap guard texel on each side; no resizing
texture_assets.admission: native limits and device-reported lower limits; no alternate renderer
